description_zh:
把 AI Passport 当作桌边的小电视：看自己的视频，或用电脑搜索、收藏并切换直播频道。设备按键可以调音量、换台和暂停，中文提示按需出现，让画面保持简洁。

需要电脑持续运行配套程序，可用 USB 或配对后的 Wi-Fi 传输，不能独立播放。公共直播是否可用取决于来源与网络。封面为 AI 示意图，非实机截图。
description_en:
Use AI Passport as a little TV for your desk. Watch your own videos, or search, save and switch live channels on your computer. Device buttons control volume, channels and pause, with Chinese notices appearing when needed to keep the picture clear.

A computer must keep the companion player running, over USB or paired Wi-Fi; this is not a standalone player. Public stream availability depends on the source and connection. The cover is an AI illustration, not a device screenshot.
